// era.ts.txt — SCANNED, NEVER RUN. The half of the era table that is not on
// the ecmascript timeline at all: TypeScript syntax reaches an environment
// through `env_extra` rather than through a year, and this file is what makes
// that path carry real sites instead of a claim.
//
// THE DECORATOR IS NOT HERE, and its absence is a fact about the SCANNER
// rather than about this fixture. scanners/js_ast.ts parses with
// `plugins: ['typescript']` and nothing else, so `@logged` is a hard parse
// ERROR — not a missing node, a refused file. `decorator` is nonetheless in
// the declared `node_kind` vocabulary, so the era table gates a kind this
// configuration can never produce. That is recorded as
// `feature_unscannable(decorators, a_parser_plugin_not_enabled)` rather than
// left to look like a corpus gap, which is the same distinction
// `parenthesized_expression` already forced in the call-graph corpus.
export function widen(n: number, s: string): number {
  const cast = (n as number) + 1;
  const shouted: string = s!;
  return cast + shouted.length;
}

export class Service {
  run(): string { return 'ran'; }
}
